lead.t: Post-operative care is the care of a patient after a surgical procedure, to prevent, detect and manage complications, with the main objective of reducing morbidity and mortality from surgery and anaesthesia.
lead.s: Post-operative Care and Complications of Surgery

b: Ventilate if needed; start NG feeds on about day 4 (slowly), nutrition, antibiotics.
A contrast swallow (water-soluble) at about day 5 to 10 to look for a leak. If there is no leak, remove the transanastomotic tube and start oral feeds; if a leak is present, delay feeding.
